messages:
zoe (partnerships): Quick: finalizing marketplace publish plan with CloudWave + TitanEdge. Need to align press timing, staging preview, and SI demo handoff. Who's got any hard blockers?
liam (marketing): Proposing press embargo Thu 2026-04-15 10:00 PT. Need hero image + partner quote by Tue EOD. Also want a 10s demo clip for landing hero.
tara (product): We can deliver SKU map, two screenshots, and perf snapshot by Tue noon. Will need partner logo (SVG) and trademark line.
hiro (cloudwave): Logo & trademark line coming from our PR team. PR asked for co-branded badge placement and exact caption text before sign-off.
asha (security): For the SI demo we need to approve service account TTL. Standard is 30d; partners often ask for 90d. Requesting documented justification if going beyond 30d.
zoe (partnerships): If 90d is needed, can partner file a security exception? We'll coordinate.
hiro (cloudwave): Our demo team prefers 60d. We can accept 60d if rotation hooks are in place.
asha (security): 60d is acceptable with rotation hooks and limited scope. Please ensure tokens are scoped to demo-read only.
liam (marketing): I need a staging preview link to show partner comms. Can ops give a password-protected preview URL and TTL?
deploy-bot: preview-deploy scheduled: marketplace-preview -> 2026-04-13T02:00:00Z (password-protected)
tara (product): We'll upload assets to s3://redwood-assets/marketplace/1729999001/ and include alt-text + transcript for GIF.
zoe (partnerships): Action items recap: tara upload assets Tue noon; hiro provide logo + quote Tue EOD; asha approve 60d TTL with rotation hooks; liam preps hero + blog draft. If partner sign-off misses Tue 17:00 PT we push press 24h. Any objections?
hiro (cloudwave): No objections; we'll aim for Tue 15:00 PT sign-off.
liam (marketing): Noted. I'll draft contingency copy for +24h just in case.
zoe (partnerships): Great. I'll post a short checklist doc and ping owners tomorrow morning. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
